title: Rivo hub [unlimited features]
features:
WalkSpeed Slider – Set speed to 100 with one click.

JumpPower Slider – Set jump to 150 with one click.

Infinite Jump – Toggle to jump endlessly.

Fly – Toggle fly mode (WASD + Space/Ctrl to move up/down).

Noclip – Toggle to walk through walls.

ESP Players – Toggle to see player names and health through walls.

Fullbright – Toggle to brighten the entire map.

Teleport to Random Player – Instantly teleport near a random player.

Collect All Items – Pulls nearby tools/items to your position.

Reset Character – Instantly kills your character to respawn.

Rejoin Server – Rejoins the current server.
